desc: Parse the tree input, build adjacency lists, and root the tree at vertex 1 with an iterative traversal order.
Implement the O(N) rooted-tree DP computing B[v] (best upward-attached branch size) and B1[v] (branch size with a degree-4 witness), bottom-up.
Evaluate all vertices as topmost for the degree-4 (four largest child B) and degree-1 (best child with valid B1) configurations, output the max or -1.
Verify against all three sample cases (8, -1, 11) — passed.
